SELECT
	Status = 0,
	InvoiceCode=V.InvoiceCode,
	SummaryAccount=ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SA.Name)
			FROM SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.AccCode = :acccode AND 
				SD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode), A.Name),
	code1 = V.AccCode,
	date1 = V.date,  
	name2 = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(7), V.documentcode))), 
	name1 = A.name,		
	name5 = A.AliasName,		
	value1= V.Debit,
	value2= V.Credit,
	name3 = V.Remarks,
	name4 = S.name,
	CheckNo = V.CheckNo,
	VoucherCode=V.VoucherCode,
	RowOrder=V.VRow
FROM 
	VirtualGL V, Accounts A, SubAccounts S, 
	(SELECT AccCode FROM udf_GetSummaryAccountList(:acccode) UNION SELECT :acccode) L
WHERE 
	L.AccCode = A.AccCode AND 
	(V.AccCode = A.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = A.AccCode) AND 
	A.restricted='N' AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	Status = 0,
	InvoiceCode=V.InvoiceCode,
	SummaryAccount=ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SA.Name)
			FROM SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.AccCode = :acccode AND 
				SD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode), A.Name),
	code1 = V.AccCode, 
	date1 = V.date, 
	name2 = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(7), V.documentcode))), 
	name1 = A.name,		
	name5 = A.AliasName,		
	value1= V.Credit,
	value2= V.Debit,
	name3 = Case debit 
			When 0 then 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
			Else 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))),
	name4 = S.name,
	CheckNo = V.CheckNo,
	VoucherCode=V.VoucherCode,
	RowOrder=V.VRow
FROM 
	VirtualGL V, Accounts A, SubAccounts S, 
	(SELECT AccCode FROM udf_GetSummaryAccountList(:acccode) UNION SELECT :acccode) L
WHERE 
	L.AccCode = A.AccCode AND 
	V.AlternateAccCode = A.AccCode AND 
	A.restricted='N' AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	Status = 1,
	InvoiceCode=V.DocumentCode,
	SummaryAccount=ISNULL((SELECT MAX(SA.Name)
			FROM SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SD 
			WHERE SD.AccCode = :acccode AND SD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode), A.Name),
	code1 = V.AccCode, 
	date1 = V.date, 
	name2 = '*' + V.DocumentType + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(7), V.DocumentCode))), 
	name1 = A.name,		
	name5 = A.AliasName,		
	value1= V.Debit,
	value2= V.Credit,
	name3 = V.Remarks,
	name4 = S.name,
	CheckNo = V.CheckNo,
	VoucherCode=V.VoucherCode,
	RowOrder=V.VRow
FROM 
	(SELECT * FROM DBO.Fn_GetUnposted_AccTrans()) AS V,
	Accounts A, SubAccounts S, 
	(SELECT AccCode FROM udf_GetSummaryAccountList(:acccode) UNION SELECT :acccode) L
WHERE 
	L.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	(V.AccCode = A.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = A.AccCode) AND 
	A.restricted='N' AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
ORDER BY 
	Status,
	SummaryAccount,
	Date, 
	Name2, 
	RowOrder,
	Name1, 
	Name5, 
	Debit, 
	Credit
